marc:datafield.marc:subfield: நகைக்கத்தக்கதல்ல : அம்பேத்கர் கேலிச்சித்திரங்கள் 1932- 1956 | Nakaikkattakkatalla : Ampetkar keliccittirankal 1932-1956

This book presents a unique exploration of Baba Saheb Ambedkar, focusing on the challenges faced by those dealing with caste-based discrimination in contemporary society. It delves into how Ambedkar confronted his adversaries and the messages he conveyed in the face of hostility. By examining his experiences and the difficulties of working within a system marred by prejudice, the book provides a personal and political perspective on the struggles of Dalits. It also highlights how the societal issues of seventy years ago remain relevant today. Through insightful illustrations and C. P. Sundararajan's reflections, readers will gain a deeper understanding of Ambedkar's enduring impact and his solitary yet powerful stance against injustice.
